title: HB 194 (2011-2012 (129th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 194: Election Law-revise
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) When an elector appears in a polling place to vote, the elector shall announce to the precinct election officials the elector's full name and current address and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a current and valid photo identification, a military identification, a United States passport, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the name and current address of the elector.
(section) R.C. 3509.051(A)
(quote) The absent voter shall provide identification to the election officials in the same manner as a voter who casts a ballot in person on the day of an election is required to provide identification under section 3505.18 of the Revised Code.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) If an elector has but does not have or is unable to provide to the precinct election officials any of the forms of identification required under division (A)(1) of this section, but has a social security number, the elector may provide the last four digits of the elector's social security number. Upon providing the social security number information, the elector may cast a provisional ballot ... and do either of the following: (a) Appear at the office of the board of elections not later than the close of the polls on the day of the election and provide the identification required under division (A)(1) of this section; or (b) Write the elector's social security number on the provisional ballot envelope, which number shall be verified by the board of elections with the bureau of motor vehicles.
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(4)
(quote) If an elector does not have any of the forms of identification required under division (A)(1) of this section and cannot provide the last four digits of the elector's social security number because the elector does not have a social security number, the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification that the elector cannot provide the identification required under that division or the last four digits of the elector's social security number for those reasons. Upon signing the affirmation, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) R.C. 3509.05(A)
(quote) If the elector does not provide the elector's driver's license number, state identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope, the elector also shall include in the return envelope with the identification envelope a copy of the elector's current valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, a copy of a United States passport, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the name and address of the elector.
(section) R.C. 3509.03(E)
(quote) One of the following: (1) The elector's driver's license number or state identification card number; (2) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (3) A copy of the elector's current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, a copy of a United States passport, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ...
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.20(A)
(quote) The secretary of state, by rule, shall establish a secure online process for voter registration. The rules shall provide for all of the following: (1) An applicant to submit a voter registration application to the secretary of state online through the internet;
(section) R.C. 3503.05
(quote) The secretary of state shall establish, by rule, a uniform process for notifying individuals who have submitted an incomplete voter registration application of the incomplete status of that application. The process shall permit such an individual to provide any information required to complete the application.
(other) R.C. 3.02, 7.101, 302.09, 305.02, 503.24, 511.27, 733.31, 1545.21, 1901.10, 2101.44, 2301.02: local office vacancy / special election timing and related cross-reference changes
(other) R.C. 3501.xx: election definitions, boards of elections operations and staffing, bulk purchase of supplies (3501.302), contracts between boards (3501.111), rules for suits against election officials (3501.40, 3501.50)
(other) R.C. 3503.xx: voter registration (incomplete application process 3503.05; online registration 3503.20; acknowledgment notices 3503.22; challenges 3503.24; cancellations); repeals 3503.18
(other) R.C. 3504.01: former Ohio electors may vote a presidential ballot after moving out of state
(other) R.C. 3505.xx: ballot, polling place and provisional ballot rules (3505.181-3505.183); 3505.05 removal of a local issue from the ballot before the 70th day; 3505.21 observers
(other) R.C. 3506.021: electronic pollbooks may replace poll lists
(other) R.C. 3509.xx / 3511.xx: absentee voting; shortened in-person absentee period; in-person absentee rules (3509.051); uniformed and overseas voting
(other) R.C. 3513.xx: primaries and candidate petitions
(other) R.C. 3515.04, 3517.xx, 3519.xx, 3599.xx: recount, campaign finance (3517.211 bars mass mailings by local officials in the 90 days before an election), initiative and petition rules, election offenses (3599.30 bars schools from taking students to polling places)
(other) version: 00_IN: omnibus election revision with the polling-place ID list (photo ID, military ID, utility bill etc.); no passport; no cure by SSN verification
(other) version: 01_PHC: same ID text as 00_IN; adds 3509.05 text (absentee ID)
(other) version: 02_RH: same polling-place ID text as 00_IN
(other) version: 03_PH: same as 02_RH
(other) version: 04_RS: adds a United States passport to the ID lists (3505.18, 3509.03, 3509.05, 3503.19); adds provisional-ballot cure for a voter with SSN-4 (appear at board by close of polls with ID, or write SSN verified with BMV); adds 3509.051 in-person absentee ID rule
(other) version: 05_PS: same as 04_RS
(other) version: 06_EN: same ID text as 04_RS/05_PS; no photo-ID-only rule; no citizenship proof
(other) note: 2011 PDF text: struck and new words are not marked, so quoted ID wording may include words that are existing law reprinted. I identified words added in later versions by comparing versions (passport and the SSN verification option first appear in 04_RS). Long quotes are shortened with '...'. The enrolled act was later repealed by S.B. 295 (2012) before taking effect, per that bill's title. Vote mapping per brief: House passage on 02_RH, Senate passage on 04_RS, House concurrence on 05_PS (as passed by the Senate). Amendment and table votes are on floor amendments whose text I do not have.
